settings.speech.mistralApiKeyHelp: The API key is stored in the OS keyring (fallback: protected file), not in the app settings. ASR (Voxtral Transcribe) and TTS (Voxtral Speech) run server-side through Rust; the key only leaves the device toward api.mistral.ai.
settings.speech.mistralRealtime.delayHel: Lower = faster partials, possibly less accuracy (typical 240–960).
settings.speech.mistralRealtime.help: On: live partials and earlier speech output. Off: Phase-1 batch transcribe and unary TTS. On errors the pipeline automatically falls back to Phase-1.

settings.speech.modeExclusionHelp: Auto-send and speech agent are mutually exclusive: either send raw transcripts to AuraGo, or let the cloud speech model decide via tools what and when to send.
settings.speech.modeExclusionHelp.gemini: Auto-send and speech agent are mutually exclusive: either send raw transcripts to AuraGo, or let Gemini decide via tools what and when to send.
settings.speech.modeExclusionHelp.grok_v: Auto-send and speech agent are mutually exclusive: either send raw transcripts to AuraGo, or let Grok decide via tools what and when to send.
settings.speech.modeExclusionHelp.hybrid: Auto-send and speech agent are mutually exclusive: either send raw transcripts to AuraGo, or use a cloud speech agent with tools (Gemini Live / Grok Voice).
settings.speech.modeExclusionHelp.mistra: Mistral Voice transcribes your utterances (Silero endpointing) and sends the text to AuraGo; the reply is spoken via Voxtral TTS.
settings.speech.modeExclusionHelp.offlin: Auto-send and speech agent are mutually exclusive: either send raw transcripts to AuraGo, or use a cloud speech agent with tools (Gemini Live / Grok Voice).
